theme: Your last clear day before the girls arrive tomorrow.
greeting: First full day back in St. Petersburg after the Croatia charter, Dan — the calendar is empty and the girls come tomorrow at 3, so today is the runway to get ahead of the Orlando trip.

needsAttention.title: The girls' passports
needsAttention.detail: The four passport appointments need rescheduling now that you're home, and the packet is still to assemble — due today on the family travel list, and the December trip depends on it.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets for the weekend
needsAttention.detail: Tickets for the six of you are the last open item for the Sept 26–27 Disney weekend; buy them before then and check whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas sells out early; a refundable booking now costs nothing and closes the risk — it's a week overdue.

flagged.title: Tampa Gardens statement
flagged.detail: This month's statement for your mother's care posted this morning; payment is due at the office by the 5th.

flagged.title: Independent Managers Club thread
flagged.detail: You're cc'd on the exchange between Chie Mitsui and Mike Lubrano — it's moving along and doesn't need a reply from you.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail promos and cooking newsletters — Byron Talbott's fall-pumpkin run, Field Company, The Company Store, a few language-learning nudges.
inbox.clear: No security alerts and no real job-search mail — the "still waiting for your response" notes are just LinkedIn's automated pokes.

resolved: Croatia sailing charter wrapped — you landed back in St. Pete yesterday afternoon.
Yard work settled — $640 paid to Amanda yesterday.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: The first real week of autumn, and your first quiet evening home — a slow-roasted pot of squash is exactly the reset before a full house arrives tomorrow.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the clear stretch to book tonight's room and the Sept 20–Oct 5 SUV before rates climb.
Still open; a natural window to sort Disney tickets and set the passport reschedule.
Your last quiet night before Tuesday's 3 PM pickup and the Orlando stretch — bank the rest.
